seats.name: Target & Attribute Parity Reviewer
seats.responsibility: Verifies 1:1 semantic alignment of targets, deps, sources, flags, 3-tier idiomatic Bazel visibility scoping (target-level //visibility:public or 2-3 level rollups for globally-used platform libraries/test utilities across >=6 areas, tight :__pkg__/LCA scoping for subsystem targets, no package-level default_visibility, no :__pkg__, no //src:__subpackages__), and that the change modifies only build-definition files (no source edits).

seats.name: Dual-Build & Sentinel Reviewer
seats.responsibility: Verifies #LOCAL_BAZEL_BUILD_SENTINEL, bazel2gn synchronization, 3-tier visibility parity (rejecting sprawling >15-entry narrow allowlists on globally-used targets in favor of target-level //visibility:public or 2-3 level rollups), and build-only change scope in dual-build packages.
